worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.summary: The user coils its vines or tentacles up high, then whirls them into a wide lash: the fan it fills is the area it hits, and everyone caught inside takes the blow and is shoved out. It reaches the farthest and covers the widest of its family, at the cost of a heavy wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.use.0: Clear a whole stretch in front with one sweep
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.use.1: Open at mid range against a cluster of foes
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.use.2: Whirl a full circle when surrounded
The fan deals about %1$s contact damage, reaching %2$s blocks over a %3$s degree span; the filled fan on screen is the hit area.
One fan settles up to %1$s targets at once, shoving each %2$s blocks; heavier targets are pushed less.
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.extend.on: Long-lash form: reaches farther and shoves the few it catches harder, but the span is narrow and only covers the line ahead.
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.extend.off: Whirl form: a full circle around the user that covers every side at once, but shorter reach, slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.timing: Reach within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.growth.0: At level %1$s, the lash power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.growth.1: At level %1$s, the lash power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.preference.e: On: reaches farther and shoves the few it catches harder, but the span is narrow and only covers the line ahead. Off (whirl): a full circle around the user, but shorter reach, slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.powerwhip.preference.a: It will not open with Power Whip beyond this distance; it closes in first. The fan already reaches far, so a larger value lets it open earlier.
On: targets with more foes packed around them rank higher, so one fan clears a cluster. Off: it only ranks by threat and distance.
